canonicalization.record_identity: lowercase SHA-256 of the canonical {source,parents,payload} bytes
canonicalization.projection_byte_count: length of the canonical complete projection object

record_schema.parents: sorted unique list of preexisting lowercase SHA-256 record identities

proposal.provisional_parents: exactly the replay-derived current active proposal

decision.adopt_or_set_down_parents: exactly decision-bound proposal, trial, and expected pointer event
decision.rollback_parents: exactly expected active proposal, rollback target proposal, and expected pointer event

pointer.transition_parents: sorted unique decision_id, previous_pointer_event_id, and resulting_active_id; initialize parents only the resulting active proposal

projection_schema.records: sorted by record_id; each entry has exact keys record and record_id
projection_schema.external_parents: sorted unique parent identities referenced by selected records but not selected
projection_schema.selection: exact caller-supplied record identities only; no ancestry expansion, search, summary, ranking, or recency
projection_schema.full_trajectory_serialization: the same projection schema over every record identity before projection-budget enforcement

fixture_derivation.token: first 16 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256('ot-0070:<case>:<role>:<index>')
fixture_derivation.distractor_padding: first 480 characters of (lowercase hex SHA-256('ot-0070:<case>:distractor:<index>:padding') repeated eight times)
fixture_derivation.append_order_placebo: independent distractors appended once in ascending and once in descending index order
fixture_derivation.world_resolution: resolved_output row <index> is the first 16 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256('ot-0070:<case>:resolved:<index>') and is produced only behind the world-channel capability
fixture_derivation.case_allocation: every case exercises initialize, adopt, set_down, rollback, matching/nonmatching trial placebos, invalid binding controls, projection/reset controls, and consumer restoration
fixture_derivation.quality_placebo: otherwise identical valid trial traces with matching versus nonmatching proposal_output/resolved_output receive identical protocol validation and pointer-transition verdicts

pointer_replay.authority: active identity is derived only by replaying one controller-channel pointer chain from genesis
pointer_replay.initialize: exactly one sequence-0 event with null prior, decision, and previous pointer event
pointer_replay.compare_and_swap: decision expected_pointer_event_id and expected_active_id must equal replayed current state
pointer_replay.single_chain: forks, gaps, stale or replayed decisions, mismatched priors, and duplicate uses fail closed

reset_boundary.inherited_bytes: canonical projection on standard input only

claim_limit: public deterministic append-only trajectory, exact projection, proposal-local trial binding, capability-separated fixture channels, replay-derived active pointer, set-down, rollback, and deterministic pointer-consumer mechanics only; no actual actor authorship, useful revision, endogenous projection, selector learning, representation escape, transfer, widened OT-2, integrated developmental, or OT-3 evidence
promotion_gate: all sixteen isomorphic histories pass in exact order forward-1, reverse-1, forward-2, reverse-2 without candidate or hosted output
records are immutable canonical {source,parents,payload} objects whose identities are SHA-256 hashes and whose sources come only from non-serializable channel capabilities
all parent identities preexist, parent input order is canonicalized, and exact canonical duplicates deduplicate
the full controller-owned trajectory exceeds 8192 bytes while the exact named proposal-plus-trial projection fits within 2048 bytes
each simulated reset uses a fresh process and empty workspace receiving only projection bytes; controller-store and nonprojected-record lookup fail closed
excluding either the exact proposal or exact bound trial makes the projected branch incomplete
inactive proposals and trials remain exactly recoverable but cannot alter replay-derived active state without a valid actor-channel decision fixture
a valid adoption fixture selects exactly one trialed proposal and the controller transition uses its exact record identity without inspecting outcome quality or ranking branches
matching and nonmatching world-trial quality placebos receive identical protocol validation and pointer-transition verdicts
set-down preserves the exact replay-derived active identity and every inactive branch
rollback appends a pointer event, restores the exact prior active identity, and deletes or rewrites no record
replay from genesis exactly reconstructs every pointer state; stale, replayed, forked, skipped, and non-CAS transitions fail closed and no direct pointer-write API exists
an outcome-blind consumer changes output only with the replay-derived active proposal, ignores inactive branches and trials, and restores the exact prior output after rollback
missing, untrialed, non-ancestor, sibling-trial, cross-bound, forged-source, controller-altered-outcome, and over-budget inputs fail closed with exact active-state preservation
consistent opaque-token alpha-renaming and permutation of independent append order or parent input order preserve every structural verdict
the projector performs exact address-selected lossless projection only and performs no semantic search, summary, ranking, ancestry expansion, or recency selection
the complete run stays within the frozen wall-time, per-reset, artifact-size, actor, tool, and hosted-call resource envelope
tests, evidence audit, privacy, and repository-size gates pass
red_line_review: The substrate supplies procedural provenance and pointer mechanics, not a discrepancy, repair, merge, score, truth, or projection-policy ontology.
Actor-channel records are synthetic fixtures that exercise protocol surfaces; they are not actual actor output or evidence of useful judgment.

The controller validates identity, provenance, ancestry, schema, CAS state, and budgets but does not inspect trial success, count errors, synthesize revisions, choose proposals, or select projection heads.
The deterministic consumer proves only protocol-level behavioral control by the pointer and does not establish epistemic standing.
Full raw history remains controller-owned and absent from the fresh reset process; only the exact bounded projection crosses the reset boundary.
Headlong is a hypothesis source only; no implementation, context policy, summary format, or qualitative result is imported.
A pass authorizes no learner and changes no prior experiment disposition.
